# Write-free e2e: global flag matrix (Section 13.1 / REQ-030).

# quiet / verbose mutually exclusive.
exec foundry version --quiet
! stdout .
exec foundry version --verbose
stdout 'foundry '
! exec foundry version --quiet --verbose
stderr 'usage.invalid'
assert_error_id stderr usage.invalid
! exec foundry version --verbose --quiet
stderr 'usage.invalid'

# color values.
exec foundry version --color auto
stdout 'foundry '
exec foundry version --color always
stdout 'foundry '
exec foundry version --color never
stdout 'foundry '
! exec foundry version --color rainbow
stderr 'usage.invalid'

# JSON rejects human-mode flags (quiet/verbose/color).
! exec foundry version --output json --quiet
stdout 'usage.invalid'
stdout '"ok":false'
! stderr .
! exec foundry version --output json --verbose
stdout 'usage.invalid'
! stderr .
! exec foundry version --output json --color auto
stdout 'usage.invalid'
! stderr .
! exec foundry version --output json --color never
stdout 'usage.invalid'
! stderr .

# JSON alone is fine.
exec foundry version --output json
stdout '"ok":true'
! stderr .

# Invalid --output.
! exec foundry version --output yaml
stderr 'usage.invalid'

# Banned surface tokens must be unknown flags (no --offline/--force/--dry-run).
! exec foundry version --offline
stderr 'unknown flag|usage.invalid'
! exec foundry version --force
stderr 'unknown flag|usage.invalid'
! exec foundry version --overwrite
stderr 'unknown flag|usage.invalid'
! exec foundry version --dry-run
stderr 'unknown flag|usage.invalid'

# Help must teach plan is dry-run and must not mention banned tokens.
exec foundry --help
stdout 'authoritative dry run'
stdout 'no separate dry run'
! stdout '--offline'
! stdout '--force'
! stdout '--overwrite'
! stdout '--dry-run'

exec foundry plan --help
stdout 'authoritative dry run'
! stdout '--offline'
! stdout '--dry-run'
